meta.title: Navaro – sales workspace for quotes, companies and relationships
meta.description: Navaro helps sales teams manage companies, contacts, relationships, discovery and professional quotes in one workspace.

hero.badge: NAVARO Beta is ready for testing
hero.subtext: Navaro brings Company Record, contacts, relationships, discovery review and OfferGen into one workspace, so sales teams can work with current data and prepare better quotes faster.

solutions.title: What is ready today in NAVARO Beta.
solutions.subtitle: The current product foundation focuses on the sales workflow from company and contacts to quote, audit and discovery signals.

items.name: OfferGen
items.description: Create and manage quotes with PDF export, sending, statuses, public offer links and company context attached.

items.name: Company Record & Relationships
items.description: Company profiles, contacts and Relationship Hub give the sales team one view of the customer, relationships and relevant business context.

items.name: Discovery & DMF
items.description: Discovery Review and the DMF foundation are ready as a base for systematic signal processing, audit and future sales recommendations.

about.label: About us
about.title: Navaro is built from real sales workflows.
about.body1: The product is not a generic CRM. We focus on the moments where companies lose time: outdated data, scattered contacts, unclear relationships and manual quote preparation.
about.body2: That is why we connect the application, admin operations and Business Circle discovery. We validate needs with companies first, then turn them into simple working tools.

why.label: Why Navaro
why.title: One workflow instead of isolated spreadsheets and documents.

items.title: Faster quote preparation
items.text: OfferGen reduces repeated administration around creating, exporting and sending business quotes.

items.title: Data stays with companies and contacts
items.text: Company Record, contacts and relationships keep sales context together instead of scattered notes.

items.title: Audit and controlled workflow
items.text: Workspace membership lifecycle, UI and audit are ready for more controlled beta team operations.

items.title: Discovery drives the roadmap
items.text: Discovery Review, the DMF foundation and Business Circle help validate what has real value for companies.

offergenEarlyAccess.body2: We're now looking for the first companies who want to be part of its creation.
offergenEarlyAccess.body3: Your feedback will directly shape the future development of the product.
